scenes.headline: How T3-Video makes native 4K video affordable
scenes.sub: Two attention windows per token, one shared set of weights
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Loupe! A small video model now paints four K frames directly. Here's how its attention got cheap enough.

scenes.text: Keep every weight shape. Let each token attend to a local block and a strided sample of the whole video, then average the two.
scenes.mark: a local block and a strided sample of the whole video
scenes.say: The idea: keep the model's shape, but let each token see a local block and a sparse sample of the whole video, then average.

items.say: The target is a four K clip, eighty-one frames long.
The VAE shrinks each side by eight and time by four.
That leaves six hundred eighty-five thousand tokens, and full attention compares every pair.

scenes.title: Two windows, one set of weights

steps.say: Each token joins a close block: a solid tile of its neighbours.
It also joins a remote grid: as many tokens, picked every few rows and columns across the whole frame.
Both use the same weights, and the two results are averaged. No new parameters.

scenes.title: Why one window is not enough

steps.say: Close windows alone: every tile draws its own scene.
Both together, after a full fine-tune: one coherent picture.

left.title: Every fifth layer
left.say: Every fifth layer attends over a whole frame, where both windows are identical, so the work is done twice.

right.title: The other four
right.say: The other four use small tiles in changing shapes, so a boundary in one layer is open in the next.

scenes.label: one 4K clip, 50 steps, on one H20, against 22.2 hours
scenes.say: The payoff: one four K clip in about sixty-nine minutes on one GPU, instead of most of a day.

scenes.title: Theory versus measurement
scenes.note: the projections and FFN do not shrink
scenes.say: Attention gets forty-three times cheaper, but the feed-forward layers don't shrink. Count the whole model and the measured speedup is near its ceiling.

scenes.text: Attention is no longer the bill at 4K. The feed-forward layers are, plus six layers that attend twice.
scenes.say: Attention is no longer the bill at four K. The feed-forward layers are, plus six layers that attend twice.

recap: A close block and a strided grid, averaged
scenes.say: Two windows, the same weights, and about an hour per clip.
